class.name: MySQLPool
class.brief_description: A pool of reusable connections, leased out as [MySQLSession]s. Safe to share across threads.
class.description: Owns up to [member max_size] connections and hands them out one at a time via [method acquire], as a [MySQLSession]. It is the only class in this module meant to be called from several threads at once: [method acquire] itself is thread safe, even though each leased [MySQLSession] individually is not (see the [MySQLSession] class description). A session leased from the pool is not connected yet: call [method MySQLSession.connect_db] on it (or check [method MySQLSession.is_db_connected] first, since a recycled connection may already be connected). When the session is destroyed (its last reference is dropped), its connection goes back to the pool idle instead of being closed, ready for the next [method acquire]. If [method acquire] is called while the pool is already at [member max_size] and every connection is leased out, it blocks until one is released.

method.name: acquire
method.description: Returns a [MySQLSession] backed by an idle connection from the pool, creating a new one first if the pool has not yet reached [member max_size]. Blocks if the pool is full and no connection is idle. [method set_config] must be called first.

method.name: get_config
method.description: Returns the [MySQLConfig] passed to [method set_config], or [code]null[/code] if it has not been called yet.

method.name: set_config
method.description: Sets the [MySQLConfig] every connection of this pool is created with. Must be called before the first [method acquire], and cannot be changed afterwards.

members.member: Maximum number of connections the pool creates. Must be at least [code]1[/code]. Cannot be changed after the first connection has been created.
